notes.title: "Construction Playground" gets last update in Early Access!
notes.notes:
Sunlight Games has released the last update for “Construction Playground”. The update brings some optimizations and bug fixes. “Construction Playground” has already been released on Steam in Virtual Reality Early Access. The main game will be finally released soon.

In the final basic game, players will be able to control a tower crane, tear down walls with a hammer and to build walls with individual bricks. Furthermore, formwork walls can be placed and concreted. Future DLC content will expand the construction site with new environments, missions and of course cool construction vehicles and tools, such as a crawler excavator and a crawler crane.

notes.title: "Construction Playground" another major update released today!
notes.notes:
Sunlight Games has released today another major update for "Construction Playground". The update brings improvements, bug-fixes and adds new features. The most important features are the “Over-Hook-Camera” on a display in the crane as well as the possibility to save the game. "Construction Playground" was released in early December in Early Access on Steam for Virtual Reality.

Changelog:
Version 0.4, 11. March 2021
Fourth version in Early Access
- Lots of optimizations and fixes
- Optimized physics for objects
- Crane: Objects can’t collide each other and if rotated they can be pick up again.
- Objects can’t longer be unchain over houses
- Objects can’t longer be moved into the crane
- VR-hands are now at the correct position and angle
- Hammer and trowel are now rotated correctly, when use it with the left hand
- Crane: Added “over-hook-display” in cockpit
- Texts optimized
- Added more bricks
- Bricks snapping was optimized. Snapping inside each other should work
- Added red signal lights on the three top positions
- Save slots in container and saving when leaving scene

Please read the manual for more details of controlling!

notes.title: "Construction Playground" major update released today!
notes.notes:
Sunlight Games has released today a major update for "Construction Playground". The update brings quality improvements, bug-fixes and adds new features. The most important new feature is the building of walls with new bricks and mortar. "Construction Playground" was released early December in Early Access on Steam for Virtual Reality.

Changelog:
Version 0.3, 29. January 2021
Third version in Early Access

Changelog:
- Birds are now shared better
- Birds are flying now in a larger range
- Icons on the doors and ladders does now have the same rotation of the lights for the confirmation
- Icons on doors are no longer rotated
- In the crane the joysticks center when unhand them
- Building container falls now much realistic!
- New bricks with mortar
- New bricks snap now together, when they are close to each other or close at the bottom
- Mortar filled automatically or can be put on (not already snapped brick) with trowel
- Snapped bricks can be unsnapped by touch with the hammer
- You can enter the crane only from the side with the ladder
- No movement of objects into houses with the crane anymore
- Latest version info in the container on the board
- Handles in the container are animated
- Added quit button in the container
- Xmas deco removed
- New Icon

- Note: Saving will be included with next update!

The two most important features are building of walls with new bricks and mortar as well as the extended controlling of the crane. "Construction Playground" was released early December in Early Access on Steam for Virtual Reality.

notes.title: "Construction Playground" got Xmas update!
notes.notes:
Today, Sunlight Games has released an Xmas update for "Construction Playground". The update brings huge quality improvements and includes a day/night mode as well as Xmas lights to the construction site. Additionally construction containers can now be moved with the crane. "Construction Playground" was released last week in Early Access on Steam for Virtual Reality.

In the final basic game, players will be able to control a tower crane, tear down walls with two kinds of hammers and to build walls with individual bricks. Future DLC content will expand the construction site with new environments, missions and of course cool construction vehicles and tools, such as a crawler excavator and a crawler crane.

Sunlight Games is looking forward to adding ideas from the community to the game that are both meaningful and feasible.
